title: Capital Seed Update (v1.0.5)
releaseNotes:
• Capital Seed Rebrand: Official transition to Capital Seed with modernized identity and interface styling.
• Dual Business Split: Clean workspace separation for Agro-Farming & Livestock vs General Business Ventures.
• Runway Capital Planning: Milestone budgeting up to break-even, contingency buffer, and spend gating.
• Standardized PDF Engine: 11 business and compliance reports with guaranteed zero-underscore filenames.
• Actionable Audit Trail: Interactive SHA-256 chain verification, single-block inspector, and JSON/proof exports.
• Polished Recents: Redesigned Opened Pages switcher with real-time search, category filters, and quick hubs.
